latest.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
latest.description: The Mumbai-based exchange initially dismissed reports of suspicious outflows as a false alarm. It now says it lost $16 million and will absorb the loss.

latest.title: ‘Ticking time bomb’: The world's pension funds face an ageing crisis
latest.description: The world's pension systems are confronting a demographic crisis as longer lifespans and dwindling birth rates threaten to stretch retirement finances.

latest.title: Oil slides over 2% as traders weigh Saudi attack risks, demand destruction
latest.description: Oil prices fell as investors weighed the threat of further attacks on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure against concerns that elevated prices could erode demand.

latest.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
latest.description: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

latest.title: Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
latest.description: The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.

latest.title: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
latest.description: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, including artificial intelligence and data centers.

latest.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
latest.description: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

latest.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic presidential election; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
latest.description: It's the first time since Brazil returned to direct elections in 1989 that a candidate has won the final runoff after losing in the first round.

latest.title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
latest.description: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

latest.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
